node_type_id.title: Node Type Id
node_type_id.description: Node type id it was given.

cleared_fields.title: Cleared Fields
cleared_fields.description: Labels of config fields whose values were blanked because a catalog must not ship secrets.

added_libraries.title: Added Libraries
added_libraries.description: Libraries brought into the catalog alongside the node to satisfy its pins, as 'name version'.

missing_libraries.title: Missing Libraries
missing_libraries.description: Libraries the node pins that could not be added, as 'name version' - the project has them linked but never published that version. A subscriber cannot build the node until they are published and added.

replaced.title: Replaced
replaced.description: Whether this replaced a template the catalog already had, rather than adding a new one.

version.title: Version
version.description: Release version it was published as, when one was given.

400.description: Invalid slug or node type id

404.description: Catalog, project, workflow or node not found

409.description: The catalog already has that template, or the node type id is taken
